nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.tagline_en: The main engine — query styles, palettes, fonts and UX rules by product type; look it up before you decide.
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.why_zh: 把「设计感觉」变成「设计检索」，新手也能做出有依据的选择。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ui-.why_en: Turns design intuition into design retrieval — beginners get defensible choices.

nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.tagline_zh: 社媒、广告、网站 hero、印刷物的 banner 设计：多套美术方向备选，AI 生成视觉素材直接可用。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.tagline_en: Banners for social, ads, website heroes and print — multiple art directions with AI-generated visuals ready to ship.
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.why_zh: banner 是设计需求里频次最高的杂活，它把「多方向提案」这步也自动化了。
nextlevelbuilder-ui-ux-pro-max-skill-ban.why_en: Banners are design's highest-frequency chore; even the multi-direction pitch is automated.

msitarzewski-agency-agents.tagline_zh: 一整间 AI 代理公司装进口袋：前端巫师、Reddit 社区忍者、奇思注入师、现实检验官，各司其职。
msitarzewski-agency-agents.tagline_en: A whole agency in your pocket — frontend wizards, Reddit ninjas, whimsy injectors and reality checkers, each a specialist.
msitarzewski-agency-agents.why_zh: 角色化分工做得很有戏：不是一个全能 AI，而是一屋子性格分明的专家。
msitarzewski-agency-agents.why_en: The casting is the charm — not one omni-AI but a room of specialists with personality.

zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.tagline_zh: 用前端手艺做惊艳的 HTML 演示：动画丰富、可从 PPT 转换，浏览器里放映比 Keynote 还带感。
zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.tagline_en: Stunning animation-rich HTML presentations built with frontend craft — converts from PowerPoint, presents in the browser.
zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.why_zh: 网页做幻灯片的自由度是 PPT 给不了的，这件把门槛降到一句话。
zarazhangrui-frontend-slides.why_en: The browser gives freedom PowerPoint can't; this drops the barrier to one sentence.

tt-a1i-archify-archify.tagline_zh: 产出可验证的架构、时序、数据流、生命周期图：自包含 HTML 自带动效，导出清晰锐利可直接交付。
tt-a1i-archify-archify.tagline_en: Validated architecture, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams — self-contained HTML with motion, crisp exports.
tt-a1i-archify-archify.why_zh: 「可验证」是关键词：图和描述对得上号，不是好看但骗人的装饰画。
tt-a1i-archify-archify.why_en: "Verifiable" is the keyword — diagrams that match reality, not pretty fiction.

op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.tagline_zh: 歸藏风格社交卡片全家桶：小红书轮播、微信 21:9+1:1 封面对、Live Photo 动卡，28 版式 10 主题。
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.tagline_en: Guizang-style social cards — XHS carousels, WeChat cover pairs, Live Photo motion cards; 28 layouts, 10 themes.
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.why_zh: 歸藏是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，这套编辑部×瑞士风的版式体系就是他的招牌。
op7418-guizang-social-card-skill.why_en: Guizang is a top Chinese AI-design creator; this editorial-Swiss layout system is his signature.

eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.tagline_zh: 把 Obsidian 库运营成会自我改写的第二大脑：新资料改写旧页面而不是堆新笔记，越用越干净。
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.tagline_en: Runs your Obsidian vault as a self-rewriting second brain — new sources revise existing pages instead of piling notes.
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.why_zh: 「改写而非堆积」师承 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 思路，直击笔记软件越用越乱的死穴。
eugeniughelbur-obsidian-second-brain.why_en: Rewrite-don't-accumulate, à la Karpathy's LLM Wiki — aimed at the exact reason vaults rot.

francyjglisboa-agent-skill-creator.tagline_zh: 把任何工作流写成一次、装到 17 个平台：Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini 全兼容的 skill 铸造机。

nolangz-pixel2motion.tagline_zh: 把位图 Logo（PNG/截图都行）转成干净的极简 SVG，再做成丝滑动画：HTML 演示、GIF、视频全出。

agricidaniel-claude-blog.tagline_zh: 30 个子技能 + 5 个代理的博客套件：五道交付关卡，同时向 Google 排名和 AI 引用双重优化。
agricidaniel-claude-blog.tagline_en: A 30-sub-skill, 5-agent blog suite with a five-gate delivery contract — dual-optimized for Google rank and AI citation.

alisa0808-vox-director.tagline_zh: 一个主题进去，一支 Vox 风纸拼贴解说视频出来：脚本、拼贴关键帧、配音、剪辑全自动跑完。

alisa0808-vox-director.why_en: Vox's collage aesthetic is explainer royalty; this compresses the whole studio into a command.

juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.tagline_zh: 把任何 .pptx 模板「抄」成你的 PPT：gpt-image-2 模仿版式、你换内容，另附 10 套现成风格。

juneyaooo-gpt-image2-ppt-skills.why_en: "Make it look like that deck" is a real, frequent ask — layout mimicry is the clever cut-in.

dominikmartn-hue.tagline_zh: 学习任何品牌并输出完整设计系统：装一次，之后 agent 做的每个界面都长在你的品牌基因上。
dominikmartn-hue.tagline_en: Learns any brand and emits a full design system — install once, and every UI your agent builds matches your identity.
dominikmartn-hue.why_zh: 「品牌一致性」从人肉盯改变成系统保证，小团队也能有大厂级的视觉纪律。
dominikmartn-hue.why_en: Brand consistency goes from manual policing to systemic guarantee — big-co discipline for small teams.

dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.tagline_zh: 八字 + 紫微斗数精准排盘：算法库计算杜绝 AI 瞎排，三种分析模式，还能出水墨风 HTML 命盘海报。
dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.tagline_en: Bazi and Zi Wei charts computed by real algorithms (no LLM guessing), three analysis modes, plus ink-wash HTML chart posters.

dzcmemory-web-bazi-ziwei-skill.why_en: Fortune content dies on wrong charts; algorithmic casting locks that down. Taking the fun seriously is the fun.

railly-tinte-tinte.tagline_zh: agent 原生的设计系统基建：浏览、安装、预览 tinte.dev 上的主题和设计系统，换肤像装包一样。
railly-tinte-tinte.tagline_en: Agent-native design-system infrastructure — browse, install and preview themes from tinte.dev; reskinning like a package manager.
railly-tinte-tinte.why_zh: 把「换主题」做成了包管理体验，设计系统的分发从此有了正经渠道。
railly-tinte-tinte.why_en: Theming as package management — design systems finally get a proper distribution channel.

hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.tagline_zh: 学你的 Facebook 语气，按 14 天内容日历自动写并发到 FB/IG/Threads/X——实测单帖 8 万触达。

hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.why_zh: 「学语气 + 排日历 + 真发布」三步闭环，是个人 IP 运营少见的全自动解。
hao0321-claude-skill-social-post-social-.why_en: Voice-learning, calendaring and actual posting in one loop — rare full automation for personal brands.

danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.tagline_zh: 拍一张你的手写字母，产出真正可安装的字体（TTF/WOFF）：免费、开源、本地跑，不上传任何东西。
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.tagline_en: Photograph your handwriting, get a real installable font (TTF/WOFF) — free, open source, fully local, nothing uploaded.
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.why_zh: 「拥有自己笔迹的字体」是很多人想过没做过的浪漫，本地处理这点尤其体面。
danilo-znamerovszkij-draw-your-font-draw.why_en: A font of your own hand is a romance most people never act on; the local-only processing is the classy touch.

feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.tagline_zh: 电商主图与详情页的视觉策划 SOP：先判断转化驱动力锁定风格，再出分镜、图内文案和生图 Prompt。
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.tagline_en: An e-commerce visual SOP — diagnose the conversion driver, lock the campaign style, then storyboard, on-image copy and prompts.
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.why_zh: 「设计小白做出五年资深的商品图」不是吹牛，SOP 把资深设计师的判断顺序写死了。
feichanggege-ecommerce-visual-copywritin.why_en: The senior-designer-in-a-box claim holds because the SOP hard-codes a senior's decision order.

aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.tagline_zh: Jetpack Compose 全平台专家：给的每条建议都附 androidx 源码出处，Android/桌面/iOS/Web 都在行。
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.tagline_en: A Compose Multiplatform expert whose every recommendation ships with androidx source receipts — Android, desktop, iOS, web.
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.why_zh: 「带源码回执」是这件的灵魂：不是凭训练记忆答题，是翻着官方源码给你讲。
aldefy-compose-skill-compose-expert.why_en: Source receipts are the soul here — answers cited from androidx itself, not training-data vibes.

texasbedouin-vibe-check.tagline_zh: 由 12 年产品老兵带路：把纯新手的模糊点子变成能开工的计划，边建边教 GitHub 和干净代码习惯。
texasbedouin-vibe-check.tagline_en: A 12-year PM walks a total beginner from vague idea to buildable plan, teaching GitHub basics and clean habits along the way.
texasbedouin-vibe-check.why_zh: vibe coding 时代最缺的是「有人扶一把」，这件就是那只手，姿势还很专业。
texasbedouin-vibe-check.why_en: The vibe-coding era's missing ingredient is a steady hand; this is that hand, professionally trained.

alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.tagline_zh: 分析、生成、增强你项目的 CLAUDE.md：按 Anthropic 最佳实践来，支持模块化架构和技术栈定制。
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.tagline_en: Analyze, generate and enhance your project's CLAUDE.md — Anthropic best practices, modular architecture, stack-aware.
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.why_zh: CLAUDE.md 写得好坏直接决定 agent 干活质量，这件把「写好它」变成了标准工序。
alirezarezvani-claudeforge-claude-md-enh.why_en: A good CLAUDE.md decides agent quality; this makes writing one a standard procedure.

bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.tagline_zh: 人机协作的 Suno 音乐生产流：风格模板、歌词工作流、混音清单，把「玩 Suno」升级成「做音乐」。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.tagline_en: A human-plus-AI Suno production line — style templates, lyric workflows and mix checklists; from toying to producing.
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.why_zh: Suno 玩家众多但成品率低，这套流程补的正是「从段子到作品」的那段路。
bitwize-music-studio-claude-ai-music-ski.why_en: Plenty of Suno players, few finished tracks — this pack covers exactly that gap.

superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.tagline_zh: 在 Superdesign 画布上设计或重设计前端：页面、流程、全新产品都能来，出的是能交付的品味前端。
superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.tagline_en: Design or redesign frontend on the Superdesign canvas — pages, flows or brand-new products; shippable, tasteful output.
superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.why_zh: canvas 交互 + anti-slop 立场的组合拳，是「AI 设计工具」里完成度很高的一派。
superdesigndev-superdesign-skill-superde.why_en: Canvas interaction plus an anti-slop stance — one of the more finished schools of AI design tooling.

agent-sh-agnix-agnix.tagline_zh: 给 AI 配置文件做 lint：校验 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、hooks、MCP，带自动修复和 IDE 插件。
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.tagline_en: The missing linter for AI configs — validates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks and MCP, with autofixes and IDE plugins.
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.why_zh: 生态成熟的标志就是有了 linter；写 skill 的人都该装一个再发货。
agent-sh-agnix-agnix.why_en: An ecosystem is mature when it grows a linter; every skill author should run this before shipping.

irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.tagline_zh: 用 Image 2 按视觉风格库逐页出图，再组装成纯图 PPTX：风格可存、可复用、可持续积累。
irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.tagline_en: Style-driven slide images via Image 2, assembled into image-only PPTX — styles saved, reused and compounding over time.
irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.why_zh: 「可复用的视觉风格库」是这件的巧思：审美资产第一次能像代码一样沉淀。
irenerachel-visual-style-ppt-skill.why_en: The reusable style library is the trick — aesthetic assets finally compound like code.

tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.tagline_zh: 人文学者的思考伙伴：从苏格拉底式追问研究问题到 AI 使用声明，11 种模式陪你把论证磨锋利。
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.tagline_en: A thinking partner for humanities scholars — 11 modes from Socratic question-sharpening to AI-use disclosure statements.
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.why_zh: 少见的认真服务文科的 skill：它磨的是论证而不是格式，还懂学术伦理的新规矩。
tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion.why_en: A rare skill that takes the humanities seriously — sharpening arguments, not formatting, and fluent in new AI-ethics norms.

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.tagline_zh: 让 AI 写出生产级机器人软件的军规合集：ROS1/ROS2、设计模式、SOLID、测试，全套工程纪律。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.tagline_en: The field manual for production-grade robot software — ROS1/ROS2, design patterns, SOLID and testing discipline in one set.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.why_zh: 机器人代码出错的代价是物理的，这套纪律把「能跑」和「能上机」区分开了。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills.why_en: Robot bugs cost hardware; this discipline separates "runs" from "deployable".

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_zh: 机器人软件的架构模式与成熟配方：状态机、行为树、模块边界，别再用 Web 思维写机器人。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_en: Architecture patterns and proven recipes for robots — state machines, behavior trees, module boundaries; stop writing web code for hardware.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_zh: 机器人有自己的模式语言，这份配方集能少走很多「跑着跑着撞墙」的弯路。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_en: Robots have their own pattern language; these recipes prevent the drive-into-wall class of bugs.

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_zh: 把软件设计基本原则落到机器人模块开发上：职责边界、接口契约、可测性要求，从第一行代码就写对。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.tagline_en: Software fundamentals applied to robot modules — responsibility boundaries, interface contracts, testability from line one.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_zh: 原则类内容贵在「落到具体域」，它每条都带机器人场景的正反例。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-robotic.why_en: Principles matter when domain-grounded; every rule here comes with robot-specific examples.

arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.tagline_zh: ROS1 开发的最佳实践与常见天坑：节点、包管理、通信模式，维护存量机器人系统的救命手册。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.tagline_en: ROS1 best practices and classic pitfalls — nodes, packages, comms patterns; the survival manual for legacy robot stacks.
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.why_zh: 存量 ROS1 系统还要跑很多年，这份老兵经验就是它们的延寿秘籍。
arpitg1304-robotics-agent-skills-ros1-de.why_en: Legacy ROS1 will run for years yet; veteran knowledge is its life-extension kit.

k-dense-ai-mimeo.tagline_zh: 把任何领域专家「油印」成一份 SKILL.md：思维方式、判断框架、口头禅全套迁移给你的 agent。
k-dense-ai-mimeo.tagline_en: Mimeograph any expert into a SKILL.md — reasoning style, frameworks and verbal tics transplanted into your agent.
k-dense-ai-mimeo.why_zh: 「专家即技能」是个漂亮的抽象：请不动本人，就请一份他的思维方式。
k-dense-ai-mimeo.why_en: Expert-as-skill is a beautiful abstraction — can't hire the person, hire their reasoning.

k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.tagline_zh: 用 ResNet 之父何恺明的思维方式做深度学习设计：极简假设、消融实验优先、简洁到不能再删。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.tagline_en: Deep-learning design in Kaiming He's style — minimal assumptions, ablation-first, simplicity pushed to the limit.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.why_zh: 何式审美「简单到极致」影响了整个 CV 领域，做架构决策时值得请他上桌。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-kaiming-he.why_en: He's radical-simplicity aesthetic shaped modern CV; worth a seat at your architecture reviews.

k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.tagline_zh: 套用 Karpathy 的心智模型思考深度学习与 agent 工程：先看数据、端到端优先、怀疑一切抽象。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.tagline_en: Think with Karpathy's mental models — data first, end-to-end bias, and suspicion of every abstraction layer.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.why_zh: 和守则版是互补品：那件管写码习惯，这件管「像他一样想问题」。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-andrej-karpathy.why_en: Complements the guidelines skill — that one fixes coding habits, this one installs the worldview.

k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.tagline_zh: 斯坦福 NLP 掌门 Manning 的推理与架构哲学：语言学直觉 + 工程务实，做 NLP 决策的第二意见。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.tagline_en: Stanford NLP chief Manning's reasoning and philosophy — linguistic intuition with engineering pragmatism, a second opinion for NLP calls.
k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.why_zh: NLP 的品味之争很多，请一位领域宗师当「第二意见」是划算的保险。
k-dense-ai-mimeo-christopher-manning.why_en: NLP is full of taste disputes; a field patriarch as second opinion is cheap insurance.

machina-sports-sports-skills.tagline_zh: 实时体育数据 + 预测市场的开源技能组：足球、F1、Kalshi、Polymarket，零 API Key 直接用。
machina-sports-sports-skills.tagline_en: Open skills for live sports data and prediction markets — football, F1, Kalshi and Polymarket, zero API keys required.
machina-sports-sports-skills.why_zh: 「零 Key 开箱即用」在体育数据领域非常难得，看盘、做预测应用都省了接口费。
machina-sports-sports-skills.why_en: Zero-key sports data is genuinely rare — dashboards and prediction apps without the API bill.

machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.tagline_zh: 把 ESPN 赛程和 Kalshi、Polymarket 预测市场接在一起：统一看盘、赔率对比、实体检索一屏搞定。
machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.tagline_en: ESPN schedules wired to Kalshi and Polymarket — unified dashboards, odds comparison and entity search on one screen.
machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.why_zh: 赛事×预测市场的交叉视角很稀缺，做行情观察和内容选题都是利器。
machina-sports-sports-skills-markets.why_en: The sports-times-prediction-market lens is scarce — sharp for both market watching and content angles.

machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.tagline_zh: NCAA 美式橄榄球数据直连：比分、积分榜、名单、赛程、逐档播报，ESPN 与官方端点双源。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.tagline_en: College football data on tap — scores, standings, rosters, schedules and play-by-play from ESPN and official NCAA endpoints.
machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.why_zh: 垂直联赛数据封装到「一句话可查」，做内容和小工具的原料都齐了。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cfb-data.why_en: A vertical league packaged to one-line queries — raw material for content and tools alike.

machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.tagline_zh: NCAA 大学篮球数据直连：比分、排名、球员名单、赛程与比赛摘要，疯狂三月的数据后勤全包。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.tagline_en: College basketball data direct — scores, standings, rosters, schedules and game summaries; March Madness logistics covered.
machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.why_zh: March Madness 是数据内容的黄金档，这件就是那两周的弹药库。
machina-sports-sports-skills-cbb-data.why_en: March Madness is content's gold season; this is the ammo depot for those two weeks.

tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.tagline_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，它连成一套你能答辩的系统设计：来源→观点→产出三层，全程 Markdown 留痕。
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.tagline_en: Feed it papers and half-formed ideas; it links them into a defensible system design — sources, ideas, output, all on record.
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.why_zh: 「人拍板、agent 跑腿」的分工设计得很清醒，证据链留痕让结论真能答辩。
tigerless-labs-design-harness-design-har.why_en: Human adjudicates, agent runs errands — and the evidence trail makes conclusions actually defensible.

yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.tagline_zh: 用 Manim 做 3Blue1Brown 风格的数学动画：agent 自己规划分镜、写代码、渲染、按反馈修，出片有辨识度。
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.tagline_en: 3Blue1Brown-style math animations via Manim — the agent plans scenes, writes code, renders and refines on feedback.
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.why_zh: 数学可视化是教学内容的王牌，它把 Manim 陡峭的学习曲线整个铲平了。
yusuke710-manim-skill-manim-skill.why_en: Math visualization is teaching's trump card; this bulldozes Manim's learning curve flat.

phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.tagline_zh: 定义你的北极星指标和 3-5 个输入指标，连成一棵指标树：全公司往一个数字上使劲，别再各拜各的神。
phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.tagline_en: Define a North Star Metric plus 3–5 input metrics as one tree — the whole company pushes one number instead of many gods.
phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.why_zh: 指标混乱是增长团队的常见死法，一棵指标树把讨论从立场拉回数学。
phuryn-pm-skills-north-star-metric.why_en: Metric sprawl kills growth teams; one tree drags debates from opinion back to arithmetic.

wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.tagline_zh: 用 SUCCESs 框架打磨信息：简单、意外、具体、可信、情感、故事——让人听一遍就记住还愿意转述。
wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.tagline_en: Craft messages with the SUCCESs framework — simple, unexpected, concrete, credible, emotional, story — heard once, retold often.
wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.why_zh: 《Made to Stick》是传播学的常青经典，六要素清单拿来逐条对稿非常顺手。
wondelai-skills-made-to-stick.why_en: An evergreen communication classic; the six-trait checklist is perfect for auditing any draft.

alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.tagline_zh: 阿里开源的 AI 代码评审：ocr 一条命令审 Git 变更、PR、暂存区改动，评审意见直接落到行。
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.tagline_en: Alibaba's open AI code review — one `ocr` command reviews Git changes, PRs and staged diffs, comments landing on exact lines.
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.why_zh: 大厂把内部评审工具开源出来本身就是信号：工程化程度和规则库的厚度都不是玩具级。
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.why_en: A big company open-sourcing its internal reviewer is the signal — the engineering and rule depth aren't toy-grade.

blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.tagline_zh: 本地代理把每个请求路由到「最便宜的够用模型」：号称省 87% 推理费——注意流量走它家网关。
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.tagline_en: A local proxy routing each request to the cheapest capable model — claims 87% savings; note traffic goes via their gateway.
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.why_zh: token 账单是真痛点，路由思路也对；「经过第三方网关」这点我们直说，你自己权衡。
blockrunai-clawrouter-clawrouter.why_en: Token bills are a real pain and routing is the right idea; we're upfront that a third-party gateway sits in the path.

kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.tagline_zh: 有护栏的 AI 视频剪辑：FFmpeg 操作、素材分析、字幕、音频、成片改编，每一步都有据可查。
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.tagline_en: Guarded AI video editing — FFmpeg ops, media analysis, subtitles, audio and repurposing, every step source-backed.
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.why_zh: 「guarded」是它的灵魂：剪辑指令先规划后执行、可回溯，不会一刀把素材剪废。
kyanitelabs-kinocut-kinocut.why_en: The guardrails are the soul — plan-then-execute, traceable cuts, no irreversible butchery of your footage.

dimetron-pi-go-design-review.tagline_zh: 给 Go 代码库做深度设计评审：命名、结构、一致性、接口、错误处理逐维打分，附可执行修法。
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.tagline_en: Deep design review for Go codebases — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces and error handling scored, with fixes.
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.why_zh: Go 圈「能跑」和「地道」差得远，这件按维度打分的方式让评审意见特别可落地。
dimetron-pi-go-design-review.why_en: In Go, "works" and "idiomatic" are far apart; per-dimension scoring makes the feedback actionable.

dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.tagline_zh: 给 Bubble Tea 终端应用写测试的专门手册：teatest、模型断言、快照对比，Go TUI 圈的刚需冷门件。
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.tagline_en: The dedicated manual for testing Bubble Tea TUIs — teatest, model assertions and snapshot diffs; niche but essential in Go.
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.why_zh: TUI 测试资料少得可怜，这份垂直手册对写 charmbracelet 应用的人是雪中送炭。
dimetron-pi-go-bubbletea-testing.why_en: TUI testing docs are scarce; for charmbracelet builders this vertical manual is rain in a drought.

vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.tagline_zh: 专业交易软件的 UI 设计系统：面板布局、数据密度、行情配色、交互规范，盯盘界面的门道全在里面。
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.tagline_en: A design system for trading software — panel layouts, data density, market color semantics and interaction rules.
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.why_zh: 交易 UI 是设计里的特种兵领域（红绿语义、毫秒级信息密度），成体系的资料很罕见。
vanillagreencom-vstack-trading-design.why_en: Trading UI is special-forces design — color semantics, millisecond density; systematic references are rare.

vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.tagline_zh: Rust Iced 0.14 GUI 框架专家：自定义组件、overlay、Canvas、Shader、主题化，Elm 架构疑难都接。
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.tagline_en: An Iced 0.14 expert for Rust GUIs — custom widgets, overlays, Canvas, shaders, theming and Elm-architecture puzzles.
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.why_zh: Rust 桌面开发资料零散，Iced 尤甚；有个装进 agent 的老手，踩坑速度完全不同。
vanillagreencom-vstack-iced-rs.why_en: Rust desktop knowledge is scattered and Iced doubly so; an in-agent veteran changes your pace entirely.

vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.tagline_zh: 架构决策记录（ADR）全流程管理：模板、创建、检索、废止追踪、索引维护，让「当初为什么这么做」有档可查。
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.tagline_en: Full ADR lifecycle management — templates, creation, search, supersession tracking and index upkeep; "why did we do this" gets an answer.
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.why_zh: 团队最贵的失忆就是决策依据失传，ADR 是解药，这件把仪式成本降到几乎为零。
vanillagreencom-vstack-decider.why_en: The costliest amnesia is lost decision rationale; ADRs are the cure and this drops the ritual cost to nearly zero.

nowork-studio-notfair.tagline_zh: 目标驱动、循环执行的营销 agent 组：给定业务目标后 24/7 连轴转——起名就叫 NotFair，不讲武德。
nowork-studio-notfair.tagline_en: Goal-driven, loop-powered marketing agents grinding your targets 24/7 — it's called NotFair for a reason.
nowork-studio-notfair.why_zh: 「循环体 + 明确目标」是营销 agent 的正确形态，比一次性生成物料的思路高一档。
nowork-studio-notfair.why_en: Loops plus explicit goals is the right shape for marketing agents — a tier above one-shot asset generation.

costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.tagline_zh: 本地镜像的 Claude 全套文档随叫随查：白话提问、生成交互式课程和变更报告、检查新鲜度，一个 /docs 入口全包。
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.tagline_en: A local mirror of all Claude docs behind one /docs router — plain-English Q&A, interactive courses, changelog reports, freshness checks.
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.why_zh: 官方文档更新快、翻起来碎，本地镜像+路由入口把「查文档」变成一句话；一张卡顶它全家五件。
costiash-claude-code-docs-docs.why_en: Official docs move fast and fragment; a local mirror behind one router turns lookup into a sentence. One card covers the whole set.

bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.tagline_zh: 追踪并提醒台湾 .edu.tw 学生专属福利：50+ 免费订阅和额度（正版软件、云服务、AI 工具），到期前喊你续。
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.tagline_en: Tracks 50+ free subscriptions and credits for Taiwan .edu.tw students — software, cloud and AI perks, with expiry reminders.
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.why_zh: 垂直到一个群体但需求真实：学生邮箱能薅的羊毛比想象多，有人替你盯到期日更是贴心。
bingo-taiwan-taiwan-student-benefits.why_en: Hyper-vertical but genuinely needed — .edu perks run deeper than people think, and expiry-watching is the thoughtful part.

arbiterforge-codearbiter.tagline_zh: 「信不过自己就信仲裁」：一组守门 agent 对你的代码库做多方会审，改动过堂之后才准落地。
arbiterforge-codearbiter.tagline_en: "Can't trust yourself with the codebase? Trust the Arbiter" — gatekeeper agents that tribunal every change before it lands.
arbiterforge-codearbiter.why_zh: vibe coding 时代的自我防护装置：把「冲动提交」和「主分支」之间加了一道庭审。
arbiterforge-codearbiter.why_en: Self-defense for the vibe-coding era — a courtroom between your impulse and the main branch.

artokun-comfyui-mcp.tagline_zh: 本地优先的 ComfyUI 控制中枢：MCP 服务 + 侧边栏 agent，用自然语言生成图/视频/音频、搭建并运行工作流、直接改你正在跑的节点图。
artokun-comfyui-mcp.tagline_en: A local-first control plane for ComfyUI — an MCP server plus sidebar agent that generates media, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in plain language.
artokun-comfyui-mcp.why_zh: ComfyUI 的连线门槛劝退过无数人，它把「拖节点」变成「说人话」，还全程本地跑不上传素材。
artokun-comfyui-mcp.why_en: ComfyUI's node-wiring scares people off; this turns dragging nodes into plain talk, fully local, nothing uploaded.

jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.tagline_zh: 面向内容创作者的 71 件 skill 大合集：Full Send 编排、A–F 代码评审、AI 评测、CI 关卡、设计文案、SEO/AEO/GEO、Instagram 增长与上架，一条龙。
jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.tagline_en: 71 skills for creators — Full Send orchestration, A–F code review, AI evals, CI gates, design, copy, SEO/AEO/GEO and Instagram growth, end to end.
jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.why_zh: 少见地把「创作」和「工程交付」缝在一个包里，独立创作者想一站配齐可以从这翻起。
jasoncolapietro-suede-creator-skills.why_en: Rare in stitching creation and engineering delivery into one pack — a one-stop shelf for solo creators.

dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.tagline_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的「去 AI 味」全栈中文写作系统：强制注入人类观点与细节、配读者测试评估与自动图文排版，从选题到发布全自动。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.tagline_en: A full-stack Chinese writing system on Claude Code that strips AI-flavor — forces human viewpoint and detail, with reader-test evals and auto layout, from topic to publish.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.why_zh: 国产模型友好(DeepSeek/GLM/MiniMax)、还把「防 AI 味」从口号做成强制规则，是中文写作全家桶里立意很高的一套。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent.why_en: Friendly to domestic models and turning de-AI-flavor from slogan into enforced rules — a high-ambition Chinese writing suite.

dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.tagline_zh: 多阶段中文长文的总入口：接到「写一篇/从选题开始」就调度规划、写作、评审、交付全流程，简单润色翻译不触发。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.tagline_en: The master entry for multi-stage Chinese longform — "write me one / start from a topic" triggers planning, writing, review and delivery; simple edits don't.
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.why_zh: 这套系统的中枢件：把「写长文」拆成有交接的流水线，触发边界还划得很清楚，不会抢简单任务。
dongbeixiaohuo-writing-agent-workflow-pr.why_en: The system's hub — longform as a hand-off pipeline, with trigger boundaries drawn cleanly so it won't grab trivial tasks.

rampstackco-claude-skills.tagline_zh: 技术栈无关的建站合集：品牌、设计、内容、SEO、开发、运维、增长、调研，覆盖一个网站从搭建到优化的全生命周期。
rampstackco-claude-skills.tagline_en: Stack-agnostic website skills spanning brand, design, content, SEO, dev, ops, growth and research — a site's whole lifecycle in one pack.
rampstackco-claude-skills.why_zh: 「建站」被拆成八个阶段各配 skill，从零做站或接手优化都能按图索骥，胜在覆盖完整。
rampstackco-claude-skills.why_en: Splits site-building into eight staged skills — build from zero or take over and optimize; its strength is completeness.

cecilapp-cecil-cecil.tagline_zh: 官方出品的 Cecil 静态站助手：内容组织、模板编写、站点生成分门别类给指导，用 Cecil 搭站时的随身说明书。
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.tagline_en: The official helper for Cecil static sites — focused guidance on content, templates and site generation; a field manual for building with Cecil.
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.why_zh: 框架作者自己出的 skill，权威性拉满；用小众静态站生成器最缺的就是这种一手指引。
cecilapp-cecil-cecil.why_en: Shipped by the framework's own authors — maximal authority, and exactly the first-hand guidance a niche SSG lacks.

hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.tagline_zh: AI 驱动的可编辑 PPTX 全流程：建品牌/风格/版式工作区、填充原生模板、增强成稿，产出的是真能改的 PowerPoint。
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.tagline_en: An AI-driven editable-PPTX pipeline — build brand/style/layout workspaces, fill native templates, enhance finished decks; real, editable PowerPoint out.
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.why_zh: 4.4 万星不是虚的：它做的是「原生可编辑 PPTX」而非导出图片，工作区复用的设计让做系列演示特别省。
hugohe3-ppt-master-ppt-master.why_en: 44k stars earned — native editable PPTX, not exported images, with reusable workspaces that pay off across a deck series.

vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.tagline_zh: 从规格、模板或现有课程批量搭建 Canvas LMS 课程结构：模块、页面、作业、讨论区一次性生成，教师开学前的救命工具。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.tagline_en: Scaffolds full Canvas LMS course structures from specs, templates or existing courses — modules, pages, assignments and discussions in bulk.
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.why_zh: 教育垂直里的真刚需：Canvas 手工搭课极其耗时，批量脚手架把开学前那周从加班变成一下午。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-course-b.why_en: A genuine need in edtech — hand-building Canvas courses is brutal; bulk scaffolding turns the pre-term week into an afternoon.

vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.tagline_zh: 用评分量规批改 Canvas LMS 作业：单份、批量、代码执行三种策略，先跑 dry-run 再落库，安全优先不误伤成绩。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.tagline_en: Rubric-based grading for Canvas LMS — single, batch and code-execution strategies, with safety-first dry runs before anything is written.
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.why_zh: 「先 dry-run 再落库」这个安全设计对碰学生成绩的工具至关重要，敢放心批量用。
vishalsachdev-canvas-mcp-canvas-bulk-gra.why_en: The dry-run-before-write safety design is exactly what a tool touching real grades needs — batch with confidence.

axoviq-ai-synthadoc.tagline_zh: 开源的 LLM 知识编译引擎：把散乱的原始文档（Markdown、图片、Word）编译成结构化、本地优先、人可读的 Wiki，透明可查。
axoviq-ai-synthadoc.tagline_en: An open LLM knowledge-compilation engine — turns raw docs (Markdown, images, Word) into structured, local-first, human-readable wikis.
axoviq-ai-synthadoc.why_zh: 「本地优先 + 人可读 + 透明」的定位很对：它是黑箱知识库的反面，团队资料沉淀不必交给云端。
axoviq-ai-synthadoc.why_en: Local-first, human-readable and transparent — the anti-black-box knowledge base; your team's docs needn't live in someone's cloud.

xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.tagline_zh: 把长视频和直播回放 100% 本地切成竖屏爆款短片：端侧转写、LLM 找高光、9:16 重构、卡拉OK字幕，每条还给病毒潜力打分。
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.tagline_en: Cuts long videos and livestream VODs into viral vertical shorts 100% locally — on-device transcription, LLM highlight detection, 9:16 reframe, karaoke captions, per-clip virality scores.
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.why_zh: 「全程本地不上传」是它最狠的点：切片工具满地都是，但敢碰你未发布素材还不外传的极少。
xixihhhh-hotclip-hotclip.why_en: Fully local, nothing uploaded — clip tools are everywhere, but few will touch your unreleased footage without phoning home.

staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.tagline_zh: PPT 生产 agent：理解场景→推荐风格→先出大纲→逐页定义→双通路交付（内容稿/逐页视觉图/信息图），路演培训提案一把出。
staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.tagline_en: A deck-production agent — understands the scene, recommends a style, drafts an outline, defines pages, then delivers on two tracks: content decks and per-page visuals or infographics.
staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.why_zh: 「先大纲后成图」的两段式让你有干预点，还能顺手出小红书图文，中文演示场景覆盖得很全。
staruhub-claudeskills-deck-studio.why_en: The outline-then-render split gives you a checkpoint, and it doubles into Xiaohongshu carousels — broad coverage for Chinese presentation needs.

staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.tagline_zh: 专治「面向课本和 PPT 的考试」：强制你先传课本考纲，再用苏格拉底式提问引导思考，突击复习也不灌输死记。
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.tagline_en: Built for textbook-and-slides exams — it makes you upload the actual materials first, then Socratically questions you toward understanding instead of spoon-feeding.
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.why_zh: 「没材料就不辅导」这个硬约束很诚实：它逼你对着真考纲学，而不是听 AI 编一套通用答案。
staruhub-claudeskills-university-exam-pr.why_en: The no-materials-no-tutoring rule is honest — it forces study against the real syllabus, not a generic AI-invented one.

adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.tagline_zh: 把文章、笔记、推文一句话变成封面图：11 种精调风格（商业杂志头版、复古手撕拼贴、巨型透视中文标题…），小红书公众号 X 全平台通吃。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.tagline_en: Turn any article, note or tweet into a cover image in one line — 11 finely tuned styles (magazine front page, torn-paper collage, giant Chinese title…) for Xiaohongshu, WeChat and X.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.why_zh: 风格库是真下过功夫的：每种风格都标了「适合什么内容」，选风格像点菜一样准，出的封面有编辑部气质而不是 AI 糊图。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-cover.why_en: The style library is genuinely crafted — each one tagged with what content it fits, so picking feels like ordering off a menu; covers land with editorial polish, not AI mush.

adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.tagline_zh: 人、宠物、物品照片一键变头像：像素风、怪诞灵魂手绘、凌乱蜡笔宠物肖像，还能给毛孩子出一张拍立得纪念卡。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.tagline_en: Any photo of a person, pet or object becomes an avatar — pixel art, grotesque soul sketch, messy-crayon pet portrait, plus a Polaroid keepsake card for your furry friend.
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.why_zh: 宠物拍立得纪念卡这个点子戳心：不只是换个头像，是给养宠人一件想收藏、想晒的情感小物。
adrianpunk-punk-skill-punk-avatar.why_en: The pet Polaroid keepsake is the heart-tug — not just a new avatar, but a keepable, shareable memento for pet owners.

adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.tagline_zh: 上传一张你的照片生成专属 IP 角色（含四视图设定板），确认后让这个角色进入你每一篇文章——复古扁平 3D 小剧场风，配图数量随文章长短自动决定。
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.tagline_en: Upload one photo to mint your own IP character (with a four-view sheet), then send that character into every article you write — retro flat-3D vignette style, image count auto-scaled to article length.
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.why_zh: 戳中自媒体的真痛点：不是又一个「文章配图」，而是先立住你专属的视觉人格，再让它篇篇复用——同一个「你」贯穿全部内容，这是辨识度的护城河。照片不上传、不推断敏感属性，隐私也干净。
adrianpunk-punk-ip-illustrations.why_en: Nails a real creator pain — not another article-illustrator, but a way to establish your own visual persona first, then reuse it across every piece. One consistent "you" running through all your content is a recognition moat. Photos stay local; no sensitive-attribute inference.

aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.tagline_zh: 你没有的那位 GTM 联合创始人：给独自做 AI/开发工具的技术创始人——定位、找首批用户、发布、定价，全套开源，且基于真实成交打磨。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.tagline_en: The GTM co-founder you don't have — for solo technical AI/dev-tool founders: positioning, first users, launch and pricing, open-source and forged from real deals.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.why_zh: 技术创始人最缺的就是 GTM 直觉，它把这块短板做成了可执行流程；「先访谈你一次、后续所有建议都基于你的真实业务」这个设计尤其诚实，不是套教科书。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder.why_en: Technical founders lack GTM instinct most; this turns that gap into an executable process. The "interview you once, then ground every later suggestion in your real business" design is refreshingly honest, not textbook.

aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.tagline_zh: 把产品叙事从「介绍功能」重写成「开发者是英雄、某个真实趋势是反派」的故事结构——文案听起来像在说产品而不是痛点时，就该用它。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.tagline_en: Rewrites your product narrative into a story where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain — reach for it when your copy describes the product instead of the pain.
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.why_zh: 「英雄 vs 反派」的叙事框架把干巴巴的功能列表变成有代入感的故事，是技术人最不擅长、又最影响转化的一环。
aidevgtm-gtm-cofounder-positioning-and-s.why_en: The hero-vs-villain frame turns a dry feature list into a story people enter — the piece technical folks are worst at and that most moves conversion.

amelnagdy-delegate-skills.tagline_zh: 把编码任务后台派给另一个 agent CLI（Antigravity / Codex / Claude），它实现、你审 diff、你自己落 commit——一个实现者一张卡。
amelnagdy-delegate-skills.tagline_en: Delegate a coding task to a background agent CLI (Antigravity / Codex / Claude) — it implements, you review the diff, you land the commit yourself; one card per implementer.
amelnagdy-delegate-skills.why_zh: 「派活但保留落地权」的分工很清醒：让便宜的 agent 干体力活，关键的审查和提交始终在你手里，多 agent 协作里少见的克制设计。
amelnagdy-delegate-skills.why_en: Delegate-but-keep-control is a clear-headed split — cheap agents do the grunt work while review and commit stay in your hands; a rare restraint in multi-agent setups.

aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.tagline_zh: 把「给我做个图」变成一张塔夫特式的极简图表：删掉一切多余装饰、拉高数据墨水比，从他三本经典里蒸馏出的审美守则。
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.tagline_en: Turns "make me a chart" into a Tufte-compliant one — max data-ink, zero junk, distilled from his three foundational books.
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.why_zh: 数据可视化的品味天花板就是塔夫特，它把「少即是多」做成可执行规则，出的图有种克制的高级感，而不是花花绿绿。
aref-vc-tufte-claude-skill.why_en: Tufte is the ceiling of data-viz taste; this makes "less is more" executable — restrained, high-end charts instead of rainbow clutter.

coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.tagline_zh: 生成 Excalidraw 手绘风格的示意图 JSON：流程、架构、概念图都行，那种「白板随手画」的亲切感，导入即可继续拖拽编辑。
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.tagline_en: Generates Excalidraw hand-drawn diagram JSON for workflows, architectures and concepts — that whiteboard-sketch warmth, still editable on import.
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.why_zh: 手绘风比精确框图更适合讲思路、做演示，不会显得冷冰冰；产物是真 Excalidraw 文件，画完你还能自己改。
coleam00-excalidraw-diagram-skill.why_en: Hand-drawn beats rigid boxes for explaining ideas warmly; real Excalidraw files you keep editing after.

cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.tagline_zh: 把系统、云基建、安全拓扑画成暗色主题的精致架构图：自包含 HTML+SVG，一个文件走天下，放进文档或幻灯片都好看。
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.tagline_en: Renders systems, cloud infra and security topologies as polished dark-themed architecture diagrams — self-contained HTML+SVG, one file everywhere.
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.why_zh: 暗色系配色本身就比默认白底图有质感，自包含单文件省了导出和依赖的麻烦，工程汇报的门面担当。
cocoon-ai-architecture-diagram-generator.why_en: Dark themes simply look sharper than default white, and single-file output kills export hassle — a showpiece for eng reviews.

twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.tagline_zh: Paul Hudson 出品的 SwiftUI 代码评审专家：现代 API、可维护性、性能逐项审，写 iOS 界面时随身带一位业界权威。
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.tagline_en: A SwiftUI code-review expert from Paul Hudson — modern APIs, maintainability and performance checked; an authority in your pocket for iOS UI.
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.why_zh: 作者是 Hacking with Swift 的 Paul Hudson，全球 iOS 开发者的教科书作者，权威性拉满，评审意见是真行家的话。
twostraws-swiftui-agent-skill-swiftui-pr.why_en: By Paul Hudson of Hacking with Swift — the iOS world's textbook author; maximal authority, real-expert review.

sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.tagline_zh: 给你的 agent 一个能记住状态的真浏览器：导航、填表、截图、抓数据、测网页，会话之间页面状态还在，不用每次从头登录。
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.tagline_en: Gives your agent a real browser with persistent state — navigate, fill forms, screenshot, scrape and test; pages survive between sessions.
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.why_zh: 「状态持久」是它比一次性无头浏览器强的地方：登录一次后续都在，做需要保持会话的自动化特别顺。
sawyerhood-dev-browser-dev-browser.why_en: Persistent state is the edge over throwaway headless browsers — log in once, stay in; smooth for session-bound automation.

op7418-claude-to-im-skill.tagline_zh: 把当前这个 agent 会话桥接到 Telegram、Discord、飞书、QQ、微信——从手机上就能指挥你电脑里跑着的 Claude，人在外面也能派活。
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.tagline_en: Bridges your live agent session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ or WeChat — command the Claude running on your computer straight from your phone.
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.why_zh: 歸藏出品：解决「长任务要跑很久、但我得出门」的真痛点，手机上发一句就能远程指挥，agent 干完还能推给你。
op7418-claude-to-im-skill.why_en: By Guizang — solves the real pain of long tasks while you're away; command remotely from your phone, get pinged when done.

deusyu-translate-book.tagline_zh: 把整本 PDF/DOCX/EPUB 翻成任何语言：并行子 agent 分块同时翻，保留原书排版，输出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB，长书也不怕慢。
deusyu-translate-book.tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
deusyu-translate-book.why_zh: 并行子 agent 是关键：整本书串行翻要等到天荒地老，分块并行把几小时压到几十分钟，还保留排版。
deusyu-translate-book.why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.

joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.tagline_zh: 公众号、网页、YouTube、小宇宙播客、PDF——一股脑丢进去，自动整理上传 NotebookLM，生成播客/PPT/思维导图，还能建飞书文档。
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.tagline_en: WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, podcasts, PDFs — dump them in, auto-processed into NotebookLM as podcasts, slides and mind maps.
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.why_zh: 乔木出品：把「多源资料喂进 NotebookLM」这条链路全自动化了，尤其吃透了中文内容源（公众号、小宇宙），本土化到位。
joeseesun-qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm.why_en: By Qiaomu — fully automates feeding multi-source material into NotebookLM, with real fluency in Chinese sources (WeChat, Xiaoyuzhou).

neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.tagline_zh: 一位随叫随到的 D&D 5e 地下城主：管理持久战役、角色卡、战斗轮次、NPC，还带一个可选的影院式画面显示，一个人也能开团。
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.tagline_en: An on-call D&D 5e Dungeon Master — persistent campaigns, character sheets, combat tracking and NPCs, with an optional cinematic display. Solo-play ready.
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.why_zh: 跑团最难的是凑齐人和一个好 DM，它把 DM 这个位置补上了，规则、战役、NPC 全托管，一个人也能沉浸式冒险。
neuralinitiative-claude-dnd-skill-dnd.why_en: The hard part of tabletop is a good DM and a full table; this fills the DM seat — rules, campaign and NPCs managed for solo immersion.

jame581-godotprompter.tagline_zh: Godot 4.x 专用的 agent 技能框架：GDScript、场景树、节点、信号这些引擎特有的门道它都懂，做独立游戏时的引擎向导。
jame581-godotprompter.tagline_en: An agent-skills framework built for Godot 4.x — GDScript, scene trees, nodes and signals all understood; an engine guide for indie games.
jame581-godotprompter.why_zh: 通用编码 agent 不懂 Godot 的节点/信号范式，容易用 Web 思维写游戏；这个专修引擎特有模式，少走很多弯路。
jame581-godotprompter.why_en: Generic coding agents don't grok Godot's node/signal paradigm and write games with web habits; this specializes in the engine's own patterns.

wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.tagline_zh: 把 Markdown 文章直接发布到 X（推特）的 Articles 长文编辑器，格式自动对齐，省掉手动搬运和排版崩坏的折腾。
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.tagline_en: Publishes Markdown articles straight into X's Articles editor with formatting preserved — no manual copy-paste, no broken layout.
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.why_zh: 王树义出品：X 长文编辑器手动排版极其难受，它把 Markdown 到 X Articles 这一步自动化了，写完直接发。
wshuyi-x-article-publisher-skill-x-artic.why_en: By Wang Shuyi — X's Articles editor is painful to format by hand; this automates Markdown-to-X-Articles so you just publish.

adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.tagline_zh: 分析你 App 的代码库找出核心卖点，生成一套 ASO 优化的 App Store 展示截图——让下载页那几张图真正为转化服务。
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.tagline_en: Analyzes your app's codebase to surface core benefits, then generates ASO-optimized App Store screenshots — the download page that actually converts.
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.why_zh: 独立开发者最不擅长又最影响下载量的就是商店截图，它从代码反推卖点再出图，思路比空想文案聪明。
adamlyttleapps-claude-skill-aso-appstore.why_en: Store screenshots are what indies do worst and download rates need most; deriving benefits from code beats guessing at copy.

cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.tagline_zh: 5.5 万字、908 个信源、19 个行业剧本的邮件营销技能：装上它，agent 就成了你的邮件营销顾问，从自动化到诊断都能接。
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.tagline_en: A 55K-word, 908-source, 19-playbook email-marketing skill — install it and your agent becomes an email consultant, from automation to diagnostics.
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.why_zh: 内容密度惊人（5.5万字/908信源），不是泛泛而谈；邮件营销这种「细节定成败」的领域，厚实的知识库就是硬实力。
cosmoblk-email-marketing-bible.why_en: Staggering density (55K words, 908 sources), not hand-waving; in email marketing where details decide outcomes, a thick knowledge base is real muscle.

coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.tagline_zh: 丢一个 CSV 进去，自动出摘要统计、检测缺失值、画快速可视化——用 pandas 跑，拿到陌生数据先让它体检一遍。
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.tagline_en: Drop in a CSV and get summary stats, missing-value detection and quick plots — pandas under the hood; a health-check for any unfamiliar dataset.
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.why_zh: 拿到一份陌生 CSV 先跑它，几秒钟就知道数据长什么样、有没有坑，比自己手写 df.describe() 那套省事。
coffeefuelbump-csv-data-summarizer-claud.why_en: Run it first on any unfamiliar CSV — seconds to see shape, gaps and quirks; easier than hand-writing the df.describe() dance.

jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.tagline_zh: 给记者和调查报道的技能合集：事实核查、信息公开申请（FOIA）、数据新闻、学术写作——新闻这行的专业活它成套备好。
jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.tagline_en: A skills pack for journalists and investigative reporters — fact-checking, FOIA requests, data journalism and academic writing, the trade's pro tools.
jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.why_zh: 少见地认真服务新闻行业：FOIA、事实核查这些专业流程被做成了可执行技能，垂直受众的刚需。
jamditis-claude-skills-journalism.why_en: A rare pack that takes journalism seriously — FOIA and fact-checking as executable skills; a real need for a vertical audience.

tw93-waza.tagline_zh: tw93 出品：把资深工程师那些「你早就知道但懒得坚持」的好习惯，做成 Claude 能自动执行的技能——规划、UI、复盘都在。
tw93-waza.tagline_en: By tw93 — turns the senior-engineer habits you already know but skip into skills Claude runs automatically: planning, UI, review.
tw93-waza.why_zh: 作者是知名开源人 tw93，口味极正；「把好习惯自动化」这个立意戳中了「道理都懂就是做不到」的普遍痛点。
tw93-waza.why_en: By well-known open-sourcer tw93 with sharp taste; automating good habits nails the universal gap between knowing and doing.

tw93-waza-think.tagline_zh: 把粗糙的想法先逼成一份结构完整、决策到位的计划，再动手写代码——任何语言说「帮我规划一下」都能触发。
tw93-waza-think.tagline_en: Forces a rough idea into a structurally validated, decision-complete plan before any code — say "help me plan" in any language to trigger.
tw93-waza-think.why_zh: 「想清楚再写」是资深和新手最大的分野，它把这一步做成硬前置，治「边写边想、写一半推翻」的通病。
tw93-waza-think.why_en: Think-before-code is the senior/junior divide; making it a hard prerequisite cures the write-then-rethink-then-scrap habit.

tw93-waza-ui.tagline_zh: 产出有辨识度、生产级的界面：页面、组件、排版、截图驱动的细节打磨，任何语言让它做 UI 都行，出的东西不像模板。
tw93-waza-ui.tagline_en: Produces distinctive, production-grade UI — pages, components, typography and screenshot-driven polish; ask in any language, output that isn't templated.
tw93-waza-ui.why_zh: 和它同源的 think 是一对：那个管想清楚，这个管做好看，都带 tw93 的审美，出的 UI 有个性不套模板。
tw93-waza-ui.why_en: Pairs with its sibling think — that one thinks, this one styles; both carry tw93's taste, UI with personality not templates.

heygen-com-hyperframes.tagline_zh: HeyGen 出品的视频引擎：不用剪辑软件，写 HTML 就能渲染出成片——为 agent 而生，动画、字幕、转场、配音全套 16 件技能。
heygen-com-hyperframes.tagline_en: HeyGen's video engine: write HTML, render finished video — built for agents, with 16 skills covering animation, captions, seams and voiceover.
heygen-com-hyperframes.why_zh: 这是「AI 做视频」目前最扎实的一条路：视频变成可版本控制的代码，agent 能精确改一帧，而不是对着黑箱渲染碰运气。
heygen-com-hyperframes.why_en: The most solid path yet for AI video — footage becomes version-controlled code an agent can edit frame-precisely, not a black box you re-roll.

heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.tagline_zh: 一篇文章、一堆笔记、甚至一个主题词丢进去，产出一支无需露脸的解说视频——不用出镜、不用配音演员，脚本到成片一条龙。
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.tagline_en: Feed it an article, rough notes or just a topic and get a faceless explainer video out — no camera, no voice actor, script to final cut.
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.why_zh: 无脸口播是自媒体最好起量的形态，它把这条最费时的产线（脚本、画面、字幕、配音）整条自动化了。
heygen-com-hyperframes-faceless-explaine.why_en: Faceless explainers are the easiest format to scale, and this automates the whole costly pipeline: script, visuals, captions, voice.

heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.tagline_zh: 给已有的口播视频加字幕：不重渲染整片、逐句对齐口型节奏，字幕样式也按平台习惯来，短视频的标配工序它包了。
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.tagline_en: Adds captions to an existing talking-head video without re-rendering the whole thing — phrase-level timing and platform-native caption styling.
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.why_zh: 「不重渲染」是关键：改字幕不用等整片重跑，短视频反复调字幕的人会立刻感受到这个差别。
heygen-com-hyperframes-embedded-captions.why_en: No full re-render is the point — tweak captions without waiting on the whole clip; anyone iterating on shorts feels this instantly.

heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.tagline_zh: HyperFrames 的命令行开发循环：init、add、catalog、capture、lint、render 一条龙，批量出片和自动化流程全靠它。
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.tagline_en: The HyperFrames CLI dev loop — init, add, catalog, capture, lint and render; the backbone for batch production and automation.
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.why_zh: 榜单上 33.6 万安装的那件：把视频制作变成可脚本化的构建流程，批量做内容的人靠它把重复劳动交给机器。
heygen-com-hyperframes-hyperframes-cli.why_en: The 336K-install piece from the leaderboard — video as a scriptable build process, so batch creators hand repetition to the machine.

geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.tagline_zh: 中文优先的 HyperFrames 运镜导演：从一份提纲直接导出电影感短片，中文排版、字幕节奏、镜头语言都按中文内容的习惯调过。
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.tagline_en: A Chinese-first HyperFrames motion director — outline in, cinematic short out, with typography, caption rhythm and camera language tuned for Chinese content.
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.why_zh: 作者是 md2wechat 那位（已在架的中文精品作者），HyperFrames 官方件对中文排版水土不服，这件专治那个。
geekjourneyx-hyperframes-motion-director.why_en: By the author of md2wechat (already on our shelves) — the official skills stumble on Chinese typography; this one fixes exactly that.

xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.tagline_zh: 批量产出 35~45 秒竖屏手绘故事短片：黑白线条逐笔显影的那种质感，讲一个善行小故事，量产也不失手作感。
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.tagline_en: Batch-produces 35–45s vertical hand-drawn story shorts — black-line reveal animation telling a small good-deed tale, handmade feel at scale.
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.why_zh: 这种「线条逐笔画出来」的短片在中文短视频里很吃香，难点在批量还保持手作质感，它把这条产线固化了。
xiejunjie524-handdraw-story-video-handdr.why_en: Line-reveal shorts perform well on Chinese platforms; the trick is scaling without losing the handmade texture, and this pins that pipeline down.

nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.tagline_zh: 给一个网址，它抓下整个网站再做成一支视频：产品页、落地页、作品集自动变成可播放的演示片，宣发素材一键就有。
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.tagline_en: Give it a URL: it captures the whole website and turns it into a video — product pages, landing pages and portfolios become playable demo reels.
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.why_zh: 点子很妙：网站本来就是最完整的产品素材库，直接把它变成视频，省掉重新设计一遍宣传片的功夫。
nateherkai-hyperframes-student-kit-websi.why_en: A clever premise — your site is already the most complete asset library, so turning it straight into video skips designing a promo from scratch.

julianoczkowski-designer-skills.tagline_zh: 给「用 AI 做原型和产品」的设计师准备的 8 件套：设计简报、信息架构、设计令牌、设计评审、成品前端，从想清楚到做出来。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills.tagline_en: Eight skills for designers who prototype and ship with AI agents — briefs, information architecture, tokens, reviews and production frontend.
julianoczkowski-designer-skills.why_zh: 难得从设计师视角组织而非工程师视角：先立简报和信息架构再谈视觉，顺序对了产出才不是只会好看。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills.why_en: Rare in being organized from a designer's view, not an engineer's — brief and IA before visuals, so output isn't just pretty.

julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.tagline_zh: 围着你的方案连续追问，把藏着的假设、遗漏和自相矛盾一个个问出来，问到双方真的想清楚了才收——榜单第一名，75 万安装。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.tagline_en: Interrogates your plan relentlessly, surfacing hidden assumptions, gaps and contradictions until you both actually understand it. The list's #1, 756K installs.
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.why_zh: 做重要决定前给自己做一轮压力测试，比事后返工便宜太多；它的狠劲在于不许你用「差不多想过了」蒙混过关。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-grill-me.why_en: A stress test before big decisions costs far less than rework; its virtue is refusing to let "I've roughly thought it through" slide.

julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.tagline_zh: 拿着设计简报和代码库逐项评审你的界面：视觉层级、间距、一致性、可用性挨个打分，评审意见对得上原始需求。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.tagline_en: Reviews your interface against the brief and the codebase — visual hierarchy, spacing, consistency and usability scored, critique tied back to intent.
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.why_zh: 关键在「对着简报审」：不是泛泛说好看不好看，而是回答「这版有没有实现当初要解决的问题」。
julianoczkowski-designer-skills-design-r.why_en: Reviewing against the brief is the point — not vague taste talk, but whether this build solves what it set out to.

boraoztunc-skills.tagline_zh: 63 件的设计与营销军械库：暗色玻璃、拟物、粗野主义、杂志海报、阴影层次、CRO 落地页、程序化 SEO——想要什么调性都能翻到。
boraoztunc-skills.tagline_en: A 63-piece design and marketing armory — glass dark, skeuomorphic, brutalist, zine posters, layered shadows, CRO landing pages, programmatic SEO.
boraoztunc-skills.why_zh: 罕见地按「视觉调性」而不是按功能分类，找风格像翻色卡；里面单件质量参差，但好料的密度足够高。
boraoztunc-skills.why_en: Unusually organized by visual register rather than function — browsing styles feels like flipping swatches; quality varies, but the gems run dense.

boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.tagline_zh: 像设计总监一样对页面做多轮体检：层级、间距、一致性、细节逐遍挑刺，直到那种「说不上哪不对」的别扭感消失。
boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.tagline_en: Inspects a page in multiple passes like a design director — hierarchy, spacing, consistency and detail, until the "something feels off" itch is gone.
boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.why_zh: 第一版做出来之后最难的是精修，它专攻这一段：不重做，只把已有页面的粗糙处一轮轮磨掉。
boraoztunc-skills-impeccable.why_en: Polish is the hardest stage after v1, and this owns it — no redesign, just pass after pass sanding down the roughness.

boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.tagline_zh: 把广告教父奥格威的那套准则装进 agent：标题决定八成成败、说事实别耍聪明、长文案照样卖货——经典广告手艺的现代复刻。
boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.tagline_en: Installs David Ogilvy's advertising doctrine — headlines carry most of the weight, sell facts not cleverness, long copy still converts.
boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.why_zh: AI 写营销文案最容易滑向空洞漂亮话，奥格威那套「说事实、给证据」的老规矩正好是解药。
boraoztunc-skills-ogilvy-copywriting.why_en: AI marketing copy slides toward pretty emptiness; Ogilvy's insistence on facts and proof is precisely the antidote.

boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.tagline_zh: 把苹果那套界面哲学和「有物理感的流畅动效」翻译成可执行规则：层级、材质、动画曲线，做出来的东西有那股克制的贵气。
boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.tagline_en: Translates Apple's interface philosophy and fluid, physical motion into executable rules — hierarchy, materials and easing that feel expensively restrained.
boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.why_zh: 大家都想「做得像苹果」，但说不出具体怎么做；它把那种克制和物理感拆成了动效曲线与层级规则。
boraoztunc-skills-apple-design.why_en: Everyone wants "Apple-like" without being able to specify it; this decomposes that restraint and physicality into easing curves and hierarchy rules.

ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.tagline_zh: 把截图、海报、别人的 PPT 页面、HTML 或 SVG 设计稿，逆向成可编辑的 PPTX——不是贴张图，是还原成能改的元素。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.tagline_en: Reverse-engineers screenshots, posters, other people's slides, HTML or SVG into an editable PPTX — real editable elements, not a pasted image.
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.why_zh: 「看到一张好看的 PPT 页想照做」是真实高频需求，它输出的是可编辑元素而不是图片，这一步差别就是能不能用。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2ppt.why_en: "I want that slide, editable" is a real, frequent ask — and editable elements instead of a flat image is the difference between usable and not.

ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.tagline_zh: 把一张或多张图片整理成带图层的 PSD：海报拆成可单独调整的元素、多图拼成分层文件，交给设计师继续改的标准交付物。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.tagline_en: Turns one or more images into a layered PSD — posters split into separately adjustable elements, ready to hand a designer for real edits.
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.why_zh: 分层 PSD 是设计协作的通用货币，「扁平图片拆回图层」这活以前要人手描，现在一句话。
ninehills-skills-bggg-creator-image2psd.why_en: Layered PSDs are design collaboration's currency; un-flattening an image used to mean tracing by hand, now it's one sentence.

ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.tagline_zh: Skill 进化器：让一个 skill「吞噬」另一个，分析对方的长处再融进自己——想合并两套技能、或用好的那个改造差的，交给它。
ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.tagline_en: A skill evolver that makes one skill devour another — analyzing its strengths and fusing them in; for merging two skills or upgrading a weak one with a strong one.
ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.why_zh: 生态里第一批「用 skill 改造 skill」的元工具，饕餮这名字起得妙；自己攒技能库的人会用上。
ninehills-skills-bggg-skill-taotie.why_en: Among the first meta-tools for improving skills with skills, and aptly named after the mythical devourer — useful for anyone curating a library.

kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.tagline_zh: 用命令行直接操作 Obsidian 库：读写笔记、搜索、管理任务和属性——Obsidian 官方作者 kepano 亲手做的，权威一手。
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.tagline_en: Drive your Obsidian vault from the CLI — read, create, search notes and manage tasks and properties. Built by kepano, Obsidian's own creator.
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.why_zh: 作者是 Obsidian 的 CEO，比任何第三方封装都懂这个库的数据模型；agent 从此能真正读写你的第二大脑。
kepano-obsidian-skills-obsidian-cli.why_en: Written by Obsidian's CEO — nobody knows the vault data model better; your agent can finally read and write your second brain properly.

greensock-gsap-skills.tagline_zh: GSAP 官方出品的 AI 技能包：教 agent 正确使用这套业界标准动画库——时间轴、缓动、ScrollTrigger 的正确姿势全在里面。
greensock-gsap-skills.tagline_en: Official AI skills from GreenSock, teaching agents to use the industry-standard animation library correctly — timelines, easing and ScrollTrigger done right.
greensock-gsap-skills.why_zh: 动画库最怕 AI 凭记忆瞎写 API，官方亲自出的技能包等于把正确答案直接给了 agent，出的动效能跑还符合规范。
greensock-gsap-skills.why_en: Animation libraries suffer most from AI writing APIs from memory; an official skill pack hands the agent the right answers.

huggingface-skills.tagline_zh: Hugging Face 官方技能包：让 agent 直接用上模型库、数据集、Spaces 和推理接口，开源 AI 的整个生态一次接通。
huggingface-skills.tagline_en: Official Hugging Face skills that plug your agent into models, datasets, Spaces and inference — the whole open-source AI ecosystem in one connection.
huggingface-skills.why_zh: 开源模型生态的入口就是 HF，官方亲自封装比第三方包装靠谱；找模型、跑推理、拉数据集从此是一句话的事。
huggingface-skills.why_en: HF is the front door to open models, and first-party packaging beats third-party wrappers — finding models and running inference in one sentence.

jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.tagline_zh: 把 11 万星的 superpowers 全套汉化，另加 6 个中国团队原创技能：中文 commit 规范、中文 code review 话术、国内团队反模式应对。
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.tagline_en: A full Chinese localization of the 116k-star superpowers, plus six China-originated skills — Chinese commit conventions, review phrasing and local team anti-patterns.
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.why_zh: 原版的方法论很好但全英文，中文团队用起来隔一层；这版不只是翻译，还补了国内协作场景的原创件。
jnmetacode-superpowers-zh.why_en: The original methodology is strong but English-only; this isn't just translation — it adds originals for how Chinese teams actually collaborate.

xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.tagline_zh: 数学建模竞赛全流程助教：选题建模、代码求解、结果可视化到写出论文，三阶段分工还带独立质检 subagent 把关。
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.tagline_en: A full-pipeline assistant for math-modeling contests — modeling, solving in code, visualization and paper writing, with an independent QA subagent per stage.
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.why_zh: 建模竞赛最难的是三天内把建模、编程、写作三件事同时做完，它按角色分工还自带质检，是真按竞赛节奏设计的。
xiaomacoltai-math-modeling-skill.why_en: Contest pain is doing modeling, coding and writing in three days; this splits the roles and adds QA gates — designed to the real contest rhythm.

khendzel-skills-janitor.tagline_zh: 给你装的技能库做体检：左滑扔掉浪费上下文的、扫描提示注入风险、给出诚实的 token 占用账单——自称技能界的 Tinder。
khendzel-skills-janitor.tagline_en: A health check for your installed skills — swipe away context wasters, scan for prompt injection, get an honest token bill. It calls itself Tinder for skills.
khendzel-skills-janitor.why_zh: 装得多不等于装得好：它同时管三件事——省上下文、防注入、看清成本，是这个生态少见的「减法」工具。
khendzel-skills-janitor.why_en: More installed isn't better: it handles context waste, injection risk and real cost at once — a rare subtractive tool in this ecosystem.

312362115-claude-diagram.tagline_zh: 按需求自动选对图表类型再出图：流程图、泳道图、时序图、ER 图、甘特图、Kanban、Git Graph 等 29 种，直出符合规范的 PNG。
312362115-claude-diagram.tagline_en: Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.
312362115-claude-diagram.why_zh: 多数人卡在「该用哪种图」而不是「怎么画」，它先替你选型再出图，这个顺序比给一堆模板实用。
312362115-claude-diagram.why_en: Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.

312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.tagline_zh: 接手陌生项目时的导游：从全局架构到核心流程再到关键设计决策分层讲解，回答「这段代码为什么这么写」而不是列目录。
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.tagline_en: A guide for unfamiliar codebases — architecture, then core flows, then key design decisions, answering why the code is written this way instead of listing files.
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.why_zh: 「建立心智模型」这个目标定得很对：读代码的难点从来不是看不懂语法，而是不知道各部分为什么这样连。
312362115-claude-code-walkthrough.why_en: Building a mental model is the right goal — reading code is hard not because of syntax but because you can't see why parts connect.

anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.tagline_zh: 把一份文档拆成四种颜色的卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡——读完一份材料后该记什么、该防什么、该做什么一目了然。
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.tagline_en: Breaks a document into four colored cards — blue facts, green interpretation, yellow risks, red actions — so what to note, guard against and do is immediately clear.
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.why_zh: 这个颜色分层的输出格式很聪明：把「读完了」变成「能行动」，尤其适合看合同、报告、竞品资料。
anbeime-skill-antinet-four-color-cards.why_en: The color-layered output is clever — it converts "I read it" into "I can act", especially for contracts, reports and competitor material.

wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.tagline_zh: 对一篇论文做实质性诚信取证：专查 AI 生成研究（AI-Scientist 那类）的漏洞——数据对不上、引用编造、结论超出证据。
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.tagline_en: Runs a substantive-integrity forensic sweep on a paper, aimed at AI-generated research — mismatched data, fabricated citations, conclusions outstripping evidence.
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.why_zh: AI 写论文越来越多，专门反向做诚信取证的工具却极少；立意站在学术诚信这边，做法也具体。
wanshuiyin-anti-autoresearch-anti-autore.why_en: AI-written papers keep multiplying while integrity forensics stays rare; this stands on the right side and does it concretely.

komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.tagline_zh: 用对话管理整个 Home Assistant：安全地改自动化 YAML、部署脚本蓝图、排查设备失联——家里那套智能设备终于不用手写配置了。
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.tagline_en: Manage all of Home Assistant by conversation — safely edit automation YAML, deploy scripts and blueprints, debug offline devices. No more hand-written config.
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.why_zh: HA 的 YAML 配置是智能家居爱好者共同的痛，改错一行整屋自动化就哑掉；它带安全校验再部署，敢让 AI 碰真设备。
komal-skynet-claude-skill-homeassistant-.why_en: HA's YAML is the smart-home hobbyist's shared pain — one wrong line silences the house; this validates before deploying, so letting AI touch real devices is safe.

borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.tagline_zh: 用现金、积分、里程和兑换机票四路比价找出最省的飞法：搜奖励座位、算兑换比、盯放票——把「里程玩家」的手艺变成一句话。
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.tagline_en: Finds the cheapest way to fly across cash, points, miles and award tickets — searching award seats, computing redemption value and watching availability.
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.why_zh: 里程兑换的门道深、信息碎，行家和小白的机票差价能到几千块；它把那套需要泡论坛才学会的手艺自动化了。
borski-travel-hacking-toolkit.why_en: Award travel is deep and fragmented — experts and novices can pay thousands apart for the same seat; this automates craft you'd otherwise learn on forums.

mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.tagline_zh: 查任何话题最近 30 天里人们「真正在说什么」：抓 Reddit、X、YouTube、TikTok、HN 的原帖和互动数据，再综合成有出处的结论。
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.tagline_en: Finds what people actually said about any topic in the last 30 days — pulling posts and engagement from Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok and HN, then synthesizing with sources.
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.why_zh: 5.8 万星的爆款：它要的不是官方说法而是真实用户原话，做选题、验证需求、看竞品口碑时比读产品页有用一百倍。
mvanhorn-last30days-skill-last30days.why_en: A 58k-star hit that chases real user words over official positioning — worth a hundred product pages when validating demand or reading sentiment.

alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.tagline_zh: 输入一个人名或一句模糊需求，它自动深度调研、提炼思维框架，当场造出一个能用的「人物 skill」——花叔家族里的造物主。
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.tagline_en: Give it a name or even a vague need: it researches deeply, distills the mental framework, and mints a working persona skill on the spot.
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.why_zh: 3 万星,而且店里张雪峰、X 导师这些都是它造出来的——「用 skill 造 skill」这条路上目前最成气候的一个。
alchaincyf-nuwa-skill.why_en: 30k stars, and it's the mother of several skills on our shelves — the most mature take yet on skills that build skills.

op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.tagline_zh: 生成单文件网页 PPT：WebGL 流体背景、演讲者视图、观众屏同步、章节幕封，两种风格——电子杂志×电子墨水,或瑞士国际主义。
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.tagline_en: Single-file web decks with WebGL fluid backgrounds, presenter view, audience-screen sync and chapter covers — in editorial-magazine or Swiss-international styles.
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.why_zh: 2.3 万星的天花板级作品:演讲者视图和双屏同步这种细节，市面上的 AI PPT 工具基本没人做,歸藏把它做进了单个 HTML。
op7418-guizang-ppt-skill.why_en: A 23k-star ceiling-setter — presenter view and dual-screen sync are details almost no AI deck tool bothers with, all inside one HTML file.

alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.tagline_zh: 用张雪峰的思维框架帮你分析教育选择和职业规划:基于 5 本著作、15+ 深度采访、30+ 一手语录提炼的 5 个心智模型和 8 条决策启发式。
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.tagline_en: Analyzes education and career choices through Zhang Xuefeng's frameworks — five mental models and eight decision heuristics distilled from five books and 15+ interviews.
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.why_zh: 高考志愿、考研、职业规划是中国家庭的刚需决策,请不到本人就请一份他的思维方式——调研扎实,不是拿网红名字贴标签。
alchaincyf-zhangxuefeng-skill.why_en: College and career decisions are high-stakes for Chinese families; if you can't hire him, hire his reasoning — and the research behind it is real, not name-dropping.

alchaincyf-darwin-skill.tagline_zh: 让你的 skill 自主进化:评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚的闭环,2.0 版还接入了微软研究院 SkillLens 的九维评测。
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.tagline_en: An autonomous skill optimizer running evaluate → improve → test → keep-or-rollback, with Microsoft Research's nine-dimension SkillLens wired into v2.0.
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.why_zh: 「带回滚的进化循环」才是真自动优化——改坏了自己退回去;接学术评测体系这一步也说明作者不是随口说进化。
alchaincyf-darwin-skill.why_en: An evolution loop with rollback is real self-optimization — a bad change reverts itself; wiring in an academic eval suite shows the author means it.

kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.tagline_zh: 让中文读起来像「一个见过事、查过材料、愿意把来龙去脉讲清楚的人」在说话:知乎长答、公众号、口播稿、小说对白都覆盖。
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.tagline_en: Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.why_zh: 六天涨到 2399 星的中文原创:它的目标不是删掉 AI 词,而是立一个具体的「人」的口吻,这比黑名单式去味高一档。
kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing.why_en: A Chinese original at 2.4k stars in six days — it installs a specific human voice rather than blacklisting AI words, a tier above word-swapping.

alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.tagline_zh: 蒸馏 Nicolas Cole、Sahil Bloom、Hormozi 等六位顶级创作者的方法论,加上对 X 开源算法的分析,给出选题—写作—增长的完整操作手册。
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.tagline_en: Distills the playbooks of six top creators — Nicolas Cole, Sahil Bloom, Hormozi and more — plus analysis of X's open-sourced algorithm into a topic-to-growth manual.
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.why_zh: 少见地把「创作者方法论」和「平台算法机制」两头都吃透:知道写什么,也知道平台为什么推它。
alchaincyf-x-mentor-skill.why_en: Rare in covering both sides — what to write and why the platform amplifies it, methodology married to algorithm.

alchaincyf-huashu-skills.tagline_zh: 花叔的内容创作 11 件套:AI 审校、选题生成、视频大纲、素材搜索、设计风格顾问——中文创作者的日常流水线。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills.tagline_en: Huashu's 11-piece content kit — AI proofreading, topic generation, video outlines, asset search and design-style advising; a Chinese creator's daily line.
alchaincyf-huashu-skills.why_zh: 和已在架的花叔设计是同一位作者的另一条产品线:这套管「内容」,那套管「视觉」,都是他自己每天在用的。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills.why_en: A second product line from the same author as our Huashu design skill — this one handles content, that one visuals; both tools he uses daily.

alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.tagline_zh: 一次给出 2-3 个视频大纲方案,每个都带标题、封面建议和结构设计——开拍之前先把方向选对,别拍到一半推翻。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.tagline_en: Delivers two or three video outline options at once, each with titles, cover suggestions and structure — pick the direction before you shoot, not halfway through.
alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.why_zh: 「一次给几个方案对比」比一口气生成一个更实用:视频最贵的是拍完发现方向错了。
alchaincyf-huashu-skills-huashu-video-ou.why_en: Options to compare beat one confident answer — the costliest video mistake is discovering the wrong direction after shooting.

joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.tagline_zh: 把一句话需求变成可复现、可验收的视频工程:素材治理、双语字幕、品牌包装、渲染留痕,每一步都能查。
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.tagline_en: Turns a one-line brief into a reproducible, reviewable video project — governed sourcing, bilingual subtitles, brand packaging and traceable renders.
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.why_zh: 「可复现 + 可验收」这两个词在 AI 视频里很少见:改一版不用从头碰运气,交付时也说得清每一帧从哪来。
joeseesun-qiaomu-cut-skill.why_en: Reproducible and reviewable are rare words in AI video — revisions don't re-roll the dice, and you can account for every frame.

joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.tagline_zh: 用一套 CLI 接通 B 站、知乎、X、YouTube、微博、小红书、V2EX、Reddit:借你已登录的 Chrome 会话取内容,不用申请 API。
joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.tagline_en: One CLI reaching Bilibili, Zhihu, X, YouTube, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, V2EX and Reddit — using your logged-in Chrome session, no API applications.
joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.why_zh: 中文平台的 API 基本申请不到,它走「复用你自己的登录态」这条路,把最难拿的中文语料变成可抓的。
joeseesun-qiaomu-opencli-skills.why_en: Chinese platform APIs are effectively unobtainable; reusing your own logged-in session makes the hardest corpus reachable.

op7418-logo-generator-skill.tagline_zh: 生成专业级 SVG logo 和高级感展示图:矢量输出可无损缩放,顺手给你出一套品牌应用场景效果图。
op7418-logo-generator-skill.tagline_en: Generates professional SVG logos plus high-end showcase renders — vector output that scales losslessly, with brand mockups thrown in.
op7418-logo-generator-skill.why_zh: 输出是矢量而不是位图,这一点决定了能不能真用在产品上;歸藏出品,审美有保证。
op7418-logo-generator-skill.why_en: Vector, not raster — that alone decides whether a logo is usable in production. And it's Guizang's, so the taste is vetted.
